description: This file implements the OemLock class for managing OEM lock states in a secure environment, including reading and writing lock flags and initializing default states.

classes.name: OemLock
classes.description: Class providing methods to manage OEM lock state, including checking if OEM unlock is allowed or locked, and setting lock states.

methods.name: InitializeDefaultState
methods.description: Initializes the default OEM lock state in storage if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ReadFlag
methods.description: Reads a specific lock flag (bit) from storage.

methods.name: WriteFlag
methods.description: Writes a specific lock flag (bit) to storage.

methods.name: OemLock::OemLock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OEM lock object and default state.

methods.name: OemLock::IsOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by carrier.

methods.name: OemLock::IsOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by device policy.

methods.name: OemLock::IsOemUnlockAllowed
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed based on current state.

methods.name: OemLock::IsOemLocked
methods.description: Checks if OEM is currently locked.

methods.name: OemLock::SetOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by carrier.

methods.name: OemLock::SetOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by device policy.

methods.name: OemLock::SetOemLocked
methods.description: Locks or unlocks OEM based on input.
